phase44_before_after.phase44_issue: Header cards could truncate long raw model/camera strings.
phase44_before_after.phase45_fix: Header uses short operator labels and moves technical detail to panels.

phase44_before_after.phase44_issue: Fixture/live/dev truth separation was present but not visually authoritative.
phase44_before_after.phase45_fix: Truth mode is a first-class card: fixture, real_frame_dev, or live_system.

phase44_before_after.phase44_issue: Person safety could read as clear even when detector availability was uncertain.
phase44_before_after.phase45_fix: Header and logs show Person Check N/A unless the gate is enabled and clear.

phase44_before_after.phase44_issue: FOV and labels were still visually heavy.
phase44_before_after.phase45_fix: FOV fill opacity reduced, no-go zone made subtle, target label compacted.

phase44_before_after.phase44_issue: Operator Log showed a visible scrollbar in screenshots.
phase44_before_after.phase45_fix: Operator Log now displays only the latest four events with no screenshot scrollbar.
